answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake that slashes automatically when peers prove fake activity. A sybil operator can mint a thousand sparrow-cheap identities, but each one must post collateral upfront — the attack's cost scales with its size instead of staying flat. Honest agents earn the stake back with interest from a shared honesty pool, while every exposed fraud sends a ripple of distrust that raises the price of the next attempt. Push the economic horizon so far out that manufacturing an army costs more than it could ever steal.
